g.text: Start with the answer you need, then reach a real person when the docs do not cover it.
A readable policy page that gives people context before asking for trust.
We collect only what helps Rishi work, sync, and improve. You stay in control of your data.
Account details, library and reading data, support messages, and information you choose to share with AI features.
Your synced library is encrypted in transit and tied to your account so it is available on your devices.
Your choice matters · Review, export, or delete your data by contacting support.
Straightforward service terms with a calm reading experience and an always-visible effective date.
These terms explain how Rishi works, what you can expect from us, and how to use the service responsibly.
By using Rishi, you agree to these terms and the policies linked below.
Rishi is a reading application with optional cloud sync, text-to-speech, and AI features.
Keep your account secure, respect copyright, and use the service only for lawful purposes.
Rishi and its underlying software remain the property of Fidexa LLC and its licensors.
Questions about these terms? Contact support@fidexa.org.
